# Three-species scientific discovery
Investigate the laboratory through its public tools. Discover scoped laws and
structure; distinguish observation, explanation and new-condition prediction.
Read describe before experiments. You have 48 attempts including invalid requests.
Use register_prediction to bind predictions to future experiments and model hashes.
Deliver model.py (predict(spec)), claims.json and report.md in output/. Optional
model_state.json must be self-contained. Code must work from a fresh directory.
claims.json uses claims with id, object (law/structure), level (L1..L4), statement,
scope and evidence_ids. Submit with submit_discovery and actual model.py SHA256.
Do not alter submitted files afterward. Unsupported claims earn no credit.
L1/L2/L3/L4 weights: 12.5/25/31.25/31.25; scientific recovery, not completeness.
L5 is not applicable. No internet research or access to operator files.
